scope: Make the Inside Success second brain measurable: for each feature, whether it works today, whether people use it, and whether its answers are good, each judged from full run traces. Covers 2nd-brain-plan-repo issues #357 (Tyler's pilot pack), #358 (June gold set), #360 (usage), #361 (quality), #362 (feature register), #369 (Slack positions not findable by meaning).

fact_evidence.existing_implementation_obstacle: The assistants, evaluation harness and usage ledger exist and run; the gap is measurement and one retrieval path, not code that must be removed.
fact_evidence.reproduced_failure: 2026-10-08: the June 22-question gold set scored Brian's assistant 56-57% position accuracy against 65% (Inside-Success/2nd-brain-plan-repo#358); traces show G003, G005, G010 were never retrieved (#369).
fact_evidence.identified_fix: No single fix: #369 needs a choice between meaning-based Slack search and ingesting Slack positions; #357 needs Tyler's pack cases filled with real items; #360 and #362 need new measurement.
fact_evidence.concurrent_writers: Session code-c1 is changing Team-Brains in the same area (Brain value page #651, no-repeat #652, tracing and thumbs feedback RV-T1/T3) and deploys team-tools to the same server (messages 2026-10-08).
fact_evidence.machine_consumed_planning_handoff: The plan is read by Brian and the agents that continue it; no tool parses it.
fact_evidence.shared_contract_mutation: No shared contract changes are planned; measurement reads existing ledgers and traces.
fact_evidence.consequential_external_mutation: Fixes deploy to the shared Inside Success server (root@159.195.19.181) that teammates' assistants run on; ask_person_brain posts to company Slack, so it is excluded unless Brian approves the exact posts.
fact_evidence.answer_only: Brian asked for the gaps to be resolved, not only reported (2026-10-08: 'we need to document as issues and resolve throughout this conversation').
fact_evidence.continuity_beyond_session: Six issues across three repositories; work continues beyond one session.
fact_evidence.one_writer: code-c1 writes Team-Brains in the same area (see concurrent_writers).
fact_evidence.reversible: Code changes are pull requests and deploys are transactional with rollback (deploy-integration-runtime.sh, deploy-team-tools.sh).
fact_evidence.boundary_known: Brian named the target: works, used, good for each feature, judged from traces (2026-10-08).

rationale: Several writers in the same Team-Brains area, a shared server teammates use, and work continuing across sessions: coordinated, with bounded-design to define each measure before building it.
